section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1976
title: 9 ## Metropolitan Cities : During 1976, the incidence of accidental deaths registered an increase of 7.1 percent in the Metropolitan Cities as a whole in 1976-over 1975. The Metropolitan Cities which recorded an increase in the incidence of accidental deaths were Ahmedabad (16.5 percent), Bombay (12.9 percent), Kanpur (11.3 percent), Delhi (3.7 percent) and Hyderabad (1.4 percent). The remaining three Metropolitan Cities recorded a decline and these were Madras (15.4 percent), Bangalore (7.6 percent) and Calcutta (0.2 percent). The detailed statistics are presented in Table III.
